video_title: "Estaban todos los equipos interesados " I Juancho Hernangomez · Euroleague & FRIENDS 2x01 I MARCA

quotes.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
quotes.summary_phrase: Juancho Hernangomez on his early development with Quino Colom
quotes.excerpt: Quino Colom was one of the best veterans I have had in my life.
quotes.quote: I was 17 or 18 years old. It was my first time being on the first team with Estudiantes, and Quino Colom was one of the best veterans I have had in my life. He taught me a lot. He took care of me like a little brother. He would stay with me after practice to shoot, he would always invite me to dinner, he would invite me to everything. It is something I have learned to always do for the young players, to help them and teach them.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo tendría 17 o 18, era la primera vez ya que era primer equipo con Estudiantes, y Quino pues yo siempre lo digo que fue de los mejores veteranos que he tenido en mi vida. Me enseñó mucho, me cuidó como un hermano pequeño más, se quedaba conmigo después de entrenar a tirar, me invitaba siempre a cenar, siempre me invitaba a todo y es una cosa que luego yo he aprendido a siempre invitar a los pequeños por el hecho de ayudarles, de enseñarles.

quotes.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
quotes.summary_phrase: Juancho Hernangomez on learning from coach Zeljko Obradovic
quotes.excerpt: I have always been a player that likes to be coached, that likes to learn.
quotes.quote: I have always been a player that likes to be coached, that likes to learn from any coach, from any system, and to soak up how a coach can get the best version of you. I have many desires and many expectations in Panathinaikos. We have been here for two weeks and it is a completely different philosophy. You can see that he loves basketball, that he cares about every small detail, that he teaches the young players, that he teaches even us. It is noticeable that he loves it and he loves to teach.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo siempre he sido un jugador que me ha gustado ser entrenado, que me ha gustado aprender de cualquier entrenador, de cualquier sistema, de empaparme de cómo un entrenador puede sacar la mejor versión de ti. Tengo muchas ganas y muchas expectativas en Panathinaikos. Ya llevamos dos semanas y es un cambio de filosofía completamente, él se ve que ama el baloncesto, que quiere cada pequeño detalle, que enseña a los más jóvenes, que enseña incluso a nosotros también, nos enseña cualquier tipo de detalle y se nota que le encanta y le encanta enseñar.

quotes.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
quotes.summary_phrase: Juancho Hernangomez on his difficult free agency decision
quotes.excerpt: It was a difficult summer. There were offers from Europe, Maccabi, Fener, all clubs were interested.

text_blocks.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
text_blocks.text: It was a difficult summer. There were offers from Europe. Maccabi, Fener, all clubs were interested. It was a very personal decision. My family also tries to tell you, 'Well, your brother is there, but you have to choose.' It was a decision that was not easy to understand. Thanks to God, I have the position that I have, and I have all the offers. If I did not have offers, it would be easier, but it was not easy to make that decision.

text_blocks.speaker: Javi Gancedo
text_blocks.text: You had several offers, I do not think Panathinaikos was the only one.

text_blocks.speaker: Quino Colom
text_blocks.text: It was more risky. Seeing it from the outside, it was more risky than going to a Spanish team, where Spanish players with a passport are a little more protected.

text_blocks.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
text_blocks.text: My brother signed in Barcelona, he signed a great contract. He also wanted to pull me to Barcelona, he called me every day to sign in Barcelona. It was difficult, it was very difficult. There were offers from Europe, Madrid was pending, almost all the teams were interested.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Fue un verano difícil. Hubo ofertas de Europa, Maccabi, Fener, estaban todos los equipos interesados. Fue una decisión bastante personal y la familia encima también te intenta decir, bueno, tu hermano está allí, pero tú tienes que elegir. Fue una decisión que no es fácil, entenderme, gracias a Dios tengo esa posición que tengo, tengo todas las ofertas, si no tuviera ofertas pues sería más fácil, pero no fue fácil tomar esa decisión. 
Javi: Tenías varias ofertas, no creo que Panathinaikos fuera la única.
Quino: Era más arriesgado, viéndolo desde fuera era más arriesgado que ir a un equipo español, que normalmente los españoles con pasaporte estás un poquito más protegido.
Juancho: Mi hermano fichó en Barcelona, firmó un gran contrato. También él quería tirarme para Barcelona, me llamaba todos los días para que fichara en Barcelona. Era difícil, era muy difícil. Había ofertas de Europa, Madrid estaba pendiente, casi todos los equipos estaban interesados.

quotes.speaker: Juancho Hernangomez
quotes.summary_phrase: Juancho Hernangomez on Dimitrios Giannakopoulos's passion for winning
quotes.excerpt: He is very caring, but the fact is he is an owner of a club that wants to win.
quotes.quote: He is very caring, but the fact is he is an owner of a club that wants to win. He craves victory. He wants to win at any limit, at any cost. I think it is more that. It is also more the face of the gallery. I have no problem with him, the truth is we get along quite well, and we both want the same thing, which is to win, for that is why we are here.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Él es bastante cariñoso, lo que pasa que es un dueño de un equipo que quiere ganar, él desea ganar. Él quiere ganar a cualquier límite, a cualquier costa. Yo pienso que es más eso, es más la cara a la galería. Yo con él no tengo ningún problema, la verdad que nos llevamos bastante bien, y los dos queremos lo mismo, que es ganar, para eso estamos aquí.
